name: czrecoil_frame_toggle_joystick
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnMenuToggleJoystick toggles the zInp joystick option.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x431950 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x431950 validates GetJoystickOption followed by SetJoystickOption(current == 0 ? 1 : 0) as a tail call.
The native menu-toggle smoke verifies OnMenuToggleJoystick changes the joystick option from 0 to 1.
